welcomeSubtitle: Checks your transactions on 8 EVM chains before you sign: BNB Chain, opBNB, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism and Robinhood Chain.
step1Desc: Every transaction you sign is scanned for honeypots, rug pulls, and drainer contracts before you confirm.
step2Desc: When a transaction can be simulated, see which tokens leave and enter your wallet before you confirm.
step3Desc: High-risk transactions get a clear warning before you sign, and you choose whether to cancel or continue. If a request times out, or your wallet's chain cannot be identified or differs from the chain the transaction names, the request is refused so you can retry. Known phishing sites are flagged when you open them.
welcomeActiveMsg: ShieldBot is active. Your transactions are now monitored.
welcomeActiveOffline: Protection active — analysis server will connect when available.
welcomePermDenied: Permission denied — click again to retry
overlaySubtext: Checking contract, decoding calldata, scanning for threats
overlayApprovalNote: This signature grants token spending rights — no gas needed. Only sign for protocols you fully trust.
overlaySigNote: Signing this message costs no gas, but malicious sites can use signatures to drain wallets or impersonate you.
overlayCannotReach: Could not reach the ShieldAI API:
overlayStrictNoProceed: Strict mode is on, so there is no Proceed option. Switch to Balanced in the extension settings to decide yourself.
overlayTimedOutNote: The analysis took too long, so this request was rejected. Try the transaction again.
overlayUnknownStructureNote: ShieldAI could not read this request, so it could not check it. Reject it unless you know exactly what it does.
overlayBatchCall: Call {index} of {count} in a batch. Each call is checked on its own, and the batch is sent only if you continue on every call.
overlayUnparseableTypedNote: ShieldAI could not read this typed data, so it cannot show what you would be signing. Reject it unless you trust the site completely.
uncheckableNotice: ShieldAI rejected a wallet request from this embedded frame or popup because it cannot check requests here. Open the dApp in its own tab.
legacyRefusedNotice: This site used an older wallet method ShieldAI cannot check, so the request was refused.
overlayCoveredNote: The page is covering or altering this warning, so the button to continue is disabled until the warning is fully visible.
phishingFlagged: has been flagged as a phishing site. Your wallet and funds may be at risk.
overlayEthSignNote: eth_sign signs a raw hash, and that hash can be a transaction: signing it can let this site move everything in your wallet. No ordinary site needs it.
overlayChainNoProceed: ShieldAI could not confirm which network this request is for: the wallet's network could not be read, does not match the request, or is not supported. There is no option to continue. Switch the wallet to a supported network and try again.
siweMismatch: This sign-in message is for {domain}, but the page asking you to sign it is {origin}. A page that asks you to sign in to another site is likely phishing.
siweUnreadable: This message looks like Sign-In with Ethereum but does not follow its standard (EIP-4361), so the site it signs you in to cannot be checked.
